originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a concern on Wall Street that something called "Trumpflation" might cause the stock market to crash. This worry is growing because of rising prices (inflation) and higher interest rates on government loans (Treasury yields). The main concern is that the group in charge of money in the US (the Federal Reserve) might keep interest rates high or even raise them, which could make it harder for companies to grow and make money. This could lead to a decrease in the value of stocks, which is a problem for people who own them. The current inflation rate is 3.3%, which is higher than desired, and this is contributing to the fears about the stock market.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to raise money by selling shares to the public through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Before the IPO opens on August 10, the company has already raised Rs 281 crore from some big investors, including the World Bank's IFC and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it helps show that the company has support from important investors. The company is trying to raise a total of Rs 940 crore through its IPO, and some brokers are recommending that people buy shares, giving it a "Subscribe" rating. This means they think it's a good idea to invest in the company's IPO.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: Some companies in the stock market have recently released their financial reports, and most of them have done as well as or even better than expected. This is good news for certain parts of the market, making investors feel more positive about those areas. As a result, experts are recommending two stocks to consider buying on Monday, including Jindal Saw. This means that investors think these stocks might do well and be a good choice to buy. The recommendation is based on the positive financial reports from companies, which is a sign of good health for the market.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is measured by something called the S&P 500, has gone up by 22% over the past year. This means that if you invested in the market a year ago, your investment would be worth 22% more today. Even though the market is higher, the prices of stocks are actually considered more reasonable now, which is known as "valuations coming down". This is a positive sign because it means that investors may be getting a better deal when they buy stocks. Overall, the market is looking healthier, which could be good news for people who want to invest.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means people can buy their shares starting from August 10 to 12. At the same time, shares of eight other companies that were recently available for purchase will start trading on the market. This is important because it gives investors new opportunities to buy into these companies. The IPOs and new market listings can be a chance for investors to get involved with these companies from the start.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, or the amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251.3 crore. Its profit, which is the amount of money it made after accounting for expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and shows that the company is performing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and influence investment decisions.
